t: Magnusson laser distance measurer is a precise tool designed for professional tradespeople requiring accurate measurements. Featuring a 0-15m working range and ±2mm accuracy, the laser measurer quickly calculates distance, area, and volume. The compact device features a clear LCD display and an integrated Li-Ion battery which can be conveniently rechargead via USB-C. Ideal for indoor projects such as kitchen fitting, electrical installations, or tiling work, to ensure reliable results. Also includes an automatic switch-off feature after 2 minutes to conserve power, and an IP54 rating to allow use in demanding internal environments. Supplied with protective bag.
